result.instructions: Tools for Missive, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Missive data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run missive_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run missive_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run missive_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. missive_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: missive_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations (email/chat threads). Missive requires EXACTLY ONE mailbox-type filter — one of inbox / assigned / closed / flagged / snoozed / trashed / all / shared_label / team_inbox / team_all / organization. Missive: GET /conversations.

until.description: Unix timestamp cursor — return records older than this (offset-less pagination).

shared_label.description: Conversations under a shared label id.

team_inbox.description: Conversations in a team's inbox (team id).

team_all.description: All of a team's conversations (team id).

email.description: Filter to conversations involving this email address.

contact_organization.description: Filter to a contact organization id.

tools.name: missive_create_draft
tools.title: Create draft
tools.description: Create a draft email/message. WARNING: setting send=true SENDS a real email immediately (send_at schedules it) instead of saving a draft. Attach to an existing thread with `conversation`. Missive: POST /drafts.

conversation.description: Attach the draft to an existing conversation id.

send.description: If true, SEND the email immediately instead of saving a draft.

send_at.description: Unix timestamp to schedule the send.

add_assignees.description: User ids to assign to the conversation.

tools.description: Update a conversation — assign/unassign users, add/remove shared labels, close/reopen, move to inbox, or set subject/color/team. Missive: PATCH /conversations/{id}.

add_to_inbox.description: Move the conversation back to the inbox.

team.description: Team id to move the conversation to.
